propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) lack multi-page test coverage, exercising only single-page payloads with isLast: True despite paginating via opaque nextPageToken cursor
The cursor loop terminates on either isLast or null/absent nextPageToken, but no test asserts the cursor advances, that repeated tokens do not spin forever, or that null tokens properly stop the walk
A repeated server-side nextPageToken causes indefinite re-requesting with identical request bodies, creating silent truncation when swallowed by fail-open exception handling

Test suite must assert recovery of every seeded item across multiple pages (250 items at 100/page = 3 pages), cursor token advancement via recorded request bodies, and both stop conditions in isolation

Structural AST guard over adapters/jira/*.py must prevent future unpaginated whole-project readers posting to /rest/api/3/search/jql from being added silently on Cloud, closing a seam left by DC-only guard
